summary: Endeavour Silver Corp. filed a Form 6-K attaching a press release announcing positive drill results from its Terronera operation in Mexico. The release details exploration drilling at the La Luz and Terronera vein systems conducted since 2025, with 43 and 10 holes respectively. Highlighted intercepts include 2,607 g/t AgEq over 1.06m and 1,340 g/t AgEq over 0.94m. The filing is a routine operational update with no special-situation corporate event or offer. As a foreign private issuer, this 6-K maps to a standard press release filing under US securities law.
